process.resourceQualification: Proposed ceilings only. No deployed resource or peak-memory measurement; approve and measure before production enablement.

storage.rawEvidenceRetention: none; payloads only in bounded process memory
storage.fullBehavior: Stop acceptance without cursor advancement unless the normalized queue has already committed. Retain pending items and receipts; surface failure externally. No eviction or automatic PVC expansion.
storage.historySource: Continuously updated trusted runner-history directory mounted read-only. Read-only snapshots are suitable for offline qualification, not proof of latest live attempt.
storage.historyConstraints: Do not change active CronJobs, acquire their locks, mount their data read-write, move scanner pods, or create audit/reader Jobs under this PR. Volume access/locality and Longhorn headroom require separate rollout approval.

credentials: Use a dedicated projected short-lived API-server-audience ServiceAccount token, namespace Roles and bindings, and verified CA/HTTPS origin. Do not reuse node-agent credentials or accept source identity from log bodies. Any future static credential must be SOPS-managed; none is supplied.

network.isolation: No NetworkPolicy isolation claim. Exact-origin client authentication controls implemented; independent infrastructure egress control and denied-access probes remain an enablement gate.

operations.healthSupervisor: External private supervisor must call health on quiet ticks and detect stopped process/unwritable status. No public issue writer or new monitoring stack.
operations.identityChanges: Agent Pod replacement requires separately reviewed Pod UID/name/RBAC configuration; never widen log access to all pods. Workload UID/generation/digest changes invalidate recovery.
approvalGates: RBAC denied-access probes and authentic deployed source identities
Private history access without interfering with #2135
Resource, volume, supervision and reconnect qualification
